item: Climate: GISTEMP v4 table parser and consented fetch (A1/S2 row 1, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/gistemp.py; src/stats/fetch.py; tests/test_gistemp_parser.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: Pure parser for the NASA GISS GISTEMP v4 GLB/NH/SH table CSV (monthly plus J-D and D-N annual anomalies in degC against the stated 1951-1980 base; *** is a gap; seasonal columns stated as not emitted; refusals counted; vintages caller-stamped), fetch_gistemp behind the kill switch, registry entry gistemp-v4-table-shape, data.giss.nasa.gov on the SECURITY.md climate row and the consent popup (new Climate series lane, label x12). Built and tested on hand-made fixtures: the sandbox cannot reach the host, so the table shape is documented, not verified live. Not yet shipped: store wiring, the Statistics/Agenda surface, per-series freshness, and the other five rows.
